x: Immediately following our third man, Green, were "Jock" Martin and Bert Field, giving the finest support to our scoring team that it would be possible to have.

A little farther back were Bentley, Bidgood, Rickards and Joe King, all walking together. It was as early as this that Jock Martin was having a struggle, suffering from a touch of sunstroke, but manfully keeping going.

Jock Martin, a stalwart for many years in this race, was indisposed, as was also Fred Rickards. Readman and Roberts were also prevented from entering and we could only muster six entries against last year's eleven.
Jock Martin has recently moved to Hounslow West. Hopes to get along and meet some of his old friends.
Heartiest Congratulations to Colin Sutton and Jock Martin upon their performances in the 24 Hours' Walk, held at the White City on July 14th-15th.
"Heartiest congratulations to Colin Sutton and Jock Martin upon their performances in the 24 hours walk held at the White City on July 14th-15th.

Gordon discovered on April 4th that Keith Jennings of Exeter was a grandson of Belgrave walker R. "Jock" Martin who was a member of our winning London to Brighton Walk teams before the war and who became a Centurion in 1946 in a 24 hours event at White City.
